name: Mikiko
role: Demigod hero, leader of the Xeno Warriors ("AmenXL Mikiko"); Orenji clan; student of Komatsu Norio; ally.
appearance: A boy with a girl's name. Arm burned and bandaged after the Ultima battle (Ep 26). Wears the Fox King crown in Fox King mode (lost in Ep 29); has a work outfit for Kitsune's Farm. Nicknamed "Red Mikikies".

forms.name: Base form
forms.note: Komatsu says it is as strong as his old Fox King mode.

forms.name: Fox King mode
forms.note: Uses the Fox King crown; only works for a Fox Kin. Lost when Chase took the crown (Ep 29).

forms.name: Corrupted state
forms.note: His soul state is corrupted; anger triggers a transformation he once could not reverse (Ep 26).

forms.name: Glowing red (XL)
forms.note: Glows red after chanting "Manifest True Greatness" (Ep 27).

skills.name: True empathy
skills.description: Says what he feels and copies others' moves; used it to pull off the Dance Kick. Overuse knocked him out for 2 weeks, and Komatsu warns it can make him lose his true self.

skills.name: Dance Kick
skills.description: Komatsu Norio's signature kick, copied with True empathy.

skills.name: Karma sensing
skills.description: Senses how much Karma someone has, and dark Karma nearby or far off (Royal capital).

skills.name: Manifest Greatness / Manifest True Greatness
skills.description: A chant. Said with true belief, it powers him up and makes him glow red.

skills.name: Netsu
skills.description: Burst to top speed while running.

skills.name: Netsu Bust
skills.description: All-out speed burst; broke the treadmill.

skills.name: Heku
skills.description: Summons the Hekublade (looked different and stronger in Ep 31); sent all the C-souls into the blade.

skills.name: Kaeru return!
skills.description: Calls Kaeru back into the Hekublade.

skills.name: Hekubeats
skills.description: Kaeru turns the Hekublade into headphones so he can hear her and fight to the music.

skills.name: Two-finger catch
skills.description: Stopped Zack's knife with two fingers.

skills.name: Rap combat
skills.description: Dodges Zack's attacks while rapping to the beat, in Komatsu Norio style.

relationships: Fox Girl — former trainer and boss
Garry, Stevie — fellow students and friends
Kaeru — guardian of his Hekublade; calls him senpai
Chase — stole his Fox King crown
Ai Oni — plans to capture him
key_quote: Fighting with certainty, to ensure the battle is won.

name: Rhalix
role: Rhalix Murasaki of the Murasaki clan; captain of the Sky Patrol (SP), ex royal knight; becomes King of Royal capital Section 1; ally.
appearance: His eyes glow bright red when he is enraged (Ep 26). Kyrie restyles his hair as a disguise after the 2-year timeskip (Ep 27).

forms.name: Lunar form
forms.note: A new form, mentioned by Mikiko (Ep 26, 28).

skills.name: Kshi
skills.description: Gravity-element power that pins enemies so they can't move; also used to break apart Keita's KA.

skills.name: Gravity element
skills.description: The queens identify his power as a Gravity element.

skills.name: KA Release
skills.description: Breaks free of an enemy's KA.

skills.name: Wire knife
skills.description: Makes a knife out of his wires to cut Keita.

skills.name: Flight
skills.description: Flies between locations.

skills.name: Karma sensing
skills.description: Senses enemies' Karma nearby.

relationships: Kyrie — close ally; she has feelings for him
Sintrie/Max — teammate who betrayed him, now on probation
Lexy — teammate he aims to rescue
Ai Oni — knows him from the old world
key_quote: Never run into a king's kingdom unannounced.

name: Sintrie (Max)
role: Real name Sintrie, goes by Max; Sky Patrol fighter from the commoner islands; once tied to SR by a debt; ally.
appearance: White hair (Lexy jokes he's old as the dinosaurs). Flashback: light yellow and gray outfit, light blue wings. Smokes heavily.

skills.name: Wind of Sorrow
skills.description: His wind element; also how he travels fast.

skills.name: Vampire Slice
skills.description: His KA, a slashing strike. He calls the Ep 28 one the 2nd version and says he has reached level 3.

skills.name: KA Release
skills.description: Breaks Keita's mind-control KA.

skills.name: Rapid Vampire Slice
skills.description: Rapid slashes that drain the target's blood and can't be removed by KA Release.

skills.name: Vampire cut (healing)
skills.description: His KA heals him; closed the sword wound through his chest.

skills.name: Flight
skills.description: Flies using his wings.

relationships: Baby daughter — his child (he can't say her name because of the Kyle phone)
Rhalix — captain who beat him for betraying the team
SR Leader (Senju) — owed him a debt from Year 90
Keita, Kill — SR enemies he fought
Kyle — past betrayal left him with trust issues
key_quote: Lucky for me, I've been cleaning a lot of shit.
note: The script uses Max and Sintrie for the same person ("That's Max's real name").

name: Sam
role: Sky Patrol knight ("SP Knight Samatha" on his ID), one of SP's strongest fighters; ally.
appearance: Green hair. Wears a Karma reducing hoodie.

skills.name: Clear Space
skills.description: Teleports the target to right in front of him, or himself to them.

skills.name: Batter up!
skills.description: Bat swing that sends the enemy flying.

skills.name: PTB psychotic time bomb
skills.description: Plants bombs that go off inside the target after a 10-second countdown; killed Logan.

skills.name: Batter batter and shoot
skills.description: Finishing bat combo, used together with PTB.

key_quote: Captain was right about ending fights fast.
note: Appears as Kid Sam in the Ep 30 flashback.

name: Lexy
role: Sky Patrol member taken by SR, turned into a demon Skylander and fused with Persephone; ally.
appearance: Wore a mask and a Karma reducing hoodie at SR, then gave them up (Ep 27). No longer shy after 2 years.

forms.name: Demon Skylander / Persephone fusion
forms.note: Shares a body with Persephone and resists fully fusing with her.

forms.name: Lexy(Persephone)
forms.note: Persephone takes control of her body (Ep 28).

skills.name: High Karma
skills.description: Sam says her Karma is off the charts.

skills.name: Flight
skills.description: Flies to the Royal capital.

relationships: Keita — used her to find Max, then cut her down
key_quote: SP gave me a home and made me feel like I could be myself!

name: Persephone
role: Demon fused with Lexy and loyal to SR; enemy, though she bonds with Lexy.

skills.name: Take over
skills.description: Takes control of Lexy's body.

skills.name: Royal capital knowledge
skills.description: Knows where the Royal capital is.

relationships: Lexy — host she shares a body with
Kyrie — enemy; Kyrie killed her friend Ava
SR — group she was loyal to until Keita cut her down
key_quote: I guess Killers get to be Queens around here.

name: Komatsu Norio
role: "Master Matsu", the self-styled genuine and passionate ultimate disco dancer and rapper; runs a disco and trains Mikiko and the gang; ally.
appearance: Disco dancer; he is getting new disco outfits for the group (Ep 31).

skills.name: Dance Kick
skills.description: "The Komatsu Norio! Dance Kick!", his signature move.

skills.name: Speed
skills.description: Fast enough to keep tripping and kicking Mikiko.

skills.name: Karma teaching
skills.description: Teaches Karma through belief, certainty and the Komatsu Norio style of life.

skills.name: Treadmill-breaking sprint
skills.description: Broke the treadmill to beat Mikiko's speed record.

relationships: Fox Girl — sent Mikiko to him
key_quote: It's a part of you, you're not a part of it.

name: Stevie
role: "Purple Stevie", gang member, rapper and Komatsu Norio's student; ally.

skills.name: Karma control
skills.description: Learned Karma a month before Ep 26; knocked Mikiko out of Fox King mode.

skills.name: Dance Kick
skills.description: Hit Mikiko with the Master Matsu original.

skills.name: Rap Karma strike
skills.description: Knocks Mikiko down with Karma during rap training.

key_quote: We fight with our words, not our hands ya know!

name: Garry
role: "Green Garry", gang member and Komatsu Norio's student; ally.

skills.name: Karma control
skills.description: Learned Karma at the disco.

skills.name: Slam
skills.description: Slams Stevie during dance training.

key_quote: You're in control, not the corruption!

name: Fox Girl
role: Kitsune, Mikiko's former trainer and boss at Kitsune's Farm; ally.

skills.name: Fox martial arts
skills.description: Trained Mikiko in it, but can't anymore since she lost her fox blood.

skills.name: Throw
skills.description: Throws Mikiko all the way to Komatsu Norio's disco.

relationships: Chase — hired him, then he quit
Komatsu Norio — arranged Mikiko's training with him
key_quote: Maybe next time don't overuse your true empathy like it's some kinda toy!

name: Kaeru
role: Guardian spirit of the Hekublade, Orenji clan; ally.

skills.name: Change
skills.description: Her KA: changes into anything she chooses.

skills.name: Sound element
skills.description: Lets Mikiko hear her through headphone form.

relationships: Chase — sizes him up, decides he isn't Orenji
key_quote: No need to worry Senpai, I'm sure we will be able to fight off anyone.

name: Chase
role: Mysterious co-worker at Kitsune's Farm from Mikiko's world, sent by the old fox king to take the crown; antagonist.

skills.name: Karma control
skills.description: Knows Karma control and KAs. Even a little of his Karma far outclasses Mikiko's.

skills.name: Crown removal
skills.description: Took the Fox King crown, which then stopped working for Mikiko.

skills.name: Mind reading (suspected)
skills.description: Mikiko wonders if he can read minds.

key_quote: Tell fox girl I quit.

name: Technica
role: "Tech", a custom-made Skylander, inventor and Max's wife; ally.
appearance: Has wings she made with Yuri's help. Smokes.

skills.name: Scan
skills.description: Scans Lexy and finds something wrong.

skills.name: Invention
skills.description: Built her own wings and is making anti Kyle phones with Yuri.

skills.name: Shooting
skills.description: Shoots at Kill.

skills.name: Flight
skills.description: Flies with her custom wings.

key_quote: Being a hard working wife!

name: Yuri Tenjo
role: Ally at HQ Earth and an inventor.

skills.name: Invention
skills.description: Helped Tech make wings and anti Kyle phones.

relationships: Max — lets him stay at HQ Earth
"Big bro" — goes shopping with him (Ultima is present)
key_quote: It's all good!

name: Kyrie
role: Queen Kyrie of Royal capital Section 1, daughter of Queen Loverie and the late King; ally.

skills.name: Hairstyling
skills.description: Restyles Rhalix's hair as a disguise.

relationships: Rhalix — ally; she has feelings for him
Queen Loverie — mother, captured by SR
key_quote: Y'all got any alcohol here?
note: Appears young (age 10) in the Ep 30 flashback.

name: SR Leader (Senju)
role: Senju, leader of SR ("Father" to its members); wants a strong Skylander group to take over the Royal capital; main villain.
appearance: Carries a sword (flashback). SR members wear his hoodie.

forms.name: Split self
forms.note: Split into two halves; Kill is the other half.

skills.name: Self-splitting
skills.description: A demon/devil skill used to split himself in two.

skills.name: Demon granting
skills.description: Gives demons to members and turns people into demon vessels.

key_quote: Don't blame me for your mistakes.

name: Keita
role: SR member who calls the leader "Father"; lazy but powerful KA user; enemy. Killed by Rhalix.

skills.name: Everything I say you believe
skills.description: His KA: anyone who hears him believes and obeys what he says, even loss of sight or hearing.

skills.name: KA disable
skills.description: Turns off his own KA.

skills.name: Mass kill attack
skills.description: Killed all the guards with one attack.

relationships: SR Leader — "Father" who calls him useless
key_quote: Everything I say you believe.

name: Logan
role: SR member who calls the leader "Father"; once a knight and inside man at the Royal capital; enemy. Killed by Sam.

skills.name: Thunder flash
skills.description: Lightning strike that knocked off Sam's hoodie.

skills.name: KA
skills.description: Has a KA he only ever used on Kill and Keita; never shown.

relationships: The King — betrayed him as a knight
key_quote: Its time for him to repay his Debt!

name: Kill
role: "The first demon Skylander", secretly the other half of Senju; posed as SR's weakest; enemy.
appearance: Has demon wings like someone Max recognizes. Uses a sword.

forms.name: Senju's other half
forms.note: Speaks in the SR Leader's voice; looks younger.

skills.name: Devil skills
skills.description: Has a devil inside him and can use all of its skills.

skills.name: Sword impale
skills.description: Ran Max through; claims removing the sword kills faster.

key_quote: How would you like to die Max..

name: Zack
role: A demon SR missed, now Ai Oni's student; enemy.

skills.name: Infinite loop
skills.description: His KA: while he stays still, the target keeps repeating their action every 5 seconds and never finishes it.

key_quote: I'm a demon, you will respect my power!

name: Kaitlyn
role: Ai Oni's student who poses as a victim to lure Mikiko; enemy.

skills.name: Dark Karma
skills.description: High levels of dark Karma.

key_quote: Come on now hero show me what you got.

name: Ai Oni
role: Master of Zack and Kaitlyn, from Mikiko's old world; plots to capture Mikiko to draw out Kyle and Duo; antagonist.
relationships: Rhalix — knows him; seeing him would be an "inconvenience"
Kyle, Duo — targets she is hunting
key_quote: We need to capture a Demigod, named Mikiko.

name: Queen Koixea
role: Ranrea's mother, a queen of Section 1 and one of the late King's three wives.
relationships: Rhalix — fought him and accepted him as king
key_quote: He reminds me of the old king..

name: Queen Sainea
role: Atherea's mother, a proud queen of Section 1 and one of the late King's three wives.
key_quote: Fight us in a battle!

name: Queen Loverie
role: Kyrie's mother and ex-Queen of Section 1, held captive by SR.
key_quote: It's to create peace for y'all Kyrie.
note: Mentioned in Ep 26; appears in flashbacks.

name: The King (Section 1)
role: Kyrie's father, King of Section 1, killed in his sleep.
key_quote: Royalty is freedom and creates peace for all.
note: Only appears in the Ep 30 flashback.

name: Ultima
role: The "ultimate weapon" the Xeno Warriors defeated; now seen at HQ Earth.
relationships: Yuri Tenjo — at HQ Earth together
key_quote: Came here for your girlfriend?
